title: TaskStep
description: A step of a pass of a stage: declared ahead, then done or dropped.

number.description: Number of the step within the pass, from 1.

title.description: The step: one line of up to 120 characters.

state.description: State of the step: planned — not done yet, done — done, dropped — dropped with a reason.

check.description: How the result of a done step was checked; absent if not given.

reason.description: Why a dropped step was dropped.

source.description: Who added the step: operator or agent.

added.description: Time the step was added in UTC, RFC 3339 with milliseconds.

closed_source.description: Who marked the step done or dropped it: operator or agent.

closed.description: Time the step was done or dropped in UTC, RFC 3339 with milliseconds.
